ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}These special cones came from his side job as a high school sports coach. Twenty-five bucks each, in THIS Zomconomy?!  Totally not worth all the complaints he has to put up with from the little league's parents!
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His carefully stacked pile of sportz disc cones provides him with decent protection.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}The long standing tradition of dumping sport drink on athletes after a big win is well known to Lawnbowl Buckethead. He’s been busy practicing his technique, and is eager to show it off to his friends and enemies alike.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His freshening, fuel-filled fangear fulfills frontal fortification, fantastically.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (zeppelin) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}You would not believe the amount of brand deals Lawnbowl Balloon Zombie got to put branding on his special balloon. However, his pride was far greater than any sum of brainz or money that they could provide, and thus he branded it himself, with the thing most important to him.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HE: His big, game day zeppelin lets him float gently above the crowd.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}He's a fan of football alright, but he's still having trouble comprehending the rules of this particular match. So if a Peashooter beheaded a Buckethead before the third Gargantuar managed to squish the 5th Kernel-pult on the field, does that mean it gave the Soccer Imps the sign to run towards the house, scoring a point? You have to admit, Zombie football is one heck of a game.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}Lawnbowl Flag Zombie has been a part of every huge football-related riot since the 1960s. Between the 1961 Banana Republic vs. Zombified Zeppelins, the 1978 Wandering Weeds vs the Undead Usurpers, and the infamous 2003 Pioneering Plants vs the Dread the Dead match that ended with one of the losing Dread the Dead supporters attempting to stuff a football up the referee's nose, he has seen all of them. And always has been the one to bear the flag.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Marks the arrival of a huge exuberant "wave" of football supporters.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with goalpost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lawnbowl Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Not once have the plants been listening to his calling out of offsides, unsportsmanlike conduct, or incomplete passes. He’s been trying to move the goalposts so the plants will start paying attention, but all it’s done so far is provide a decent blunt weapon.
The ultimate defensive end on the home (invading) team.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}Lawnbowl Imp has been a huge fan of Ballpark Frank for years on end. The best lesson he learned from him was to "be the ball", so that’s what Lawnbowl Imp did. He misunderstood the lesson a bit as to WHAT ball he should be, but Lawnbowl Imp's got the can-do spirit (and flexibility) to make it work.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets passed deep into your defenses, then rolls out.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_TREADMILL_ALMANAC_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}brain gives 50% speed boost, 18% toughness boost

{FLAVOR}Cardio Zombie is all about health, healthiness and healthy lifestyles. He refuses to consume carbs, downing nothing but high-protein brains for every meal. In his opinion, other zombies really need to up their game. NO EXCUSES!
Advances to a set spot on the board, then tosses buffing brains at other zombies until he's defeated.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Lawnbowl Wizard dies

{FLAVOR}This internship under Tim has gone in a direction Lawnbowl Wizard could not have anticipated. Being forced to judge downs day in and day out is a great mental workout, but the verbal abuse from the bystanders? It can drive a good zombie to drink. He wants to tell Tim about his concerns, but unfortunately he’s too busy watching the big Lawnbowl Commercialz Zpecial, sponsored by PopSmartz.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Lawnbowl Wizard’s distance judging technique lets him turn plants into passive benchwarmers – AKA sheep.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Unlike Springening Zombie, this zombie doesn't even like Springening. The only reason he's dressed like this is because he owes Hippity-Hop Gargantuar. Don't ask what happened.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His polka-dot cone makes him twice as sturdy as normal springening zombies.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}He tried to hop into battle once and broke his legs. Don’t worry, he’s fine. He is a zombie if you couldn’t tell. He’s also part elephant. No joke.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His Easter basket hat provides excellent resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR4_RED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (eggshell) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}He likes eggs. He likes eggs very much. He was voted "most likely to like eggs" in high school, and has a huge collection of them. When he isn't fighting the plants on the lawn, he's making videos for his massively popular tutorial channel on YouTube.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR4_RED_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His head-encasing egg thoroughly protects him from attacks - and it comes in three different colors!
ZOMBIE_SPRING_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250 (egg sign) + 170
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}arrives in a group of three zombies or more

{FLAVOR}Proud members of the Egg Fan Club. Current members: 3
ZOMBIE_SPRING_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_: Walks in with a group of easter treats.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Springening Zombie never shuts up about Springening and it's driving all other zombies up the wall. If he could just stop asking for wrapped chocolate eggs he could probably do something with his unlife, like find a cone. Or a bucket.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Totally demolishes 6 year olds in Egg Hunting competitions.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pale-colored "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with carrot
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Chick Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Springening Conehead once asked Hippity-Hop Gargantuar to crush a Kernel-pult that kept him from moving. He would later regret that decision immensely.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Sometimes things cannot be unseen. This is one of those times.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}What came first? The egg, or the chicken? Answer: An imp in a chick costume.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hatches from tossed eggs, then scrambles forward.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PONCHO_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}60 (poncho) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate (1100 HP)

{FLAVOR}Springening Poncho doesn't know why everyone refers to him as Springening Poncho. He's just a regular old Poncho Zombie trying something new. "Nobody questioned Ra Zombie or Balloon Zombie when they changed outfits, why does it have to be me?" is what he would say if the only thing coming out of his mouth wasn't "brraiinz."
Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}appears on the left side of the lawn after chocolate bomb explodes
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks put out chocolate bomb

{FLAVOR}Is currently under investigations relating to missing imps incidents in local pizzeria chains.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Hops over your defenses when his chocolate-covered bomb explodes.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Springening Wizard dies

{FLAVOR}There is a certain magic to spring. This zombie does not understand second meanings.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being in the Industrial Revolution, Conehead Labor Zombie really thought he was industrially revolting with the whole cone-on-head idea. Sadly, unbeknownst to him, Jurassic Conehead had beaten him to it by a couple geologic periods.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His workshop cone provides state-of-the-art protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Labor Zombie is really glad that his stylish headwear can by chance also be utilized for labor. However, he prefers to use his worker caps for more of the dirty work.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His bucket is sure to protect him from damage and will probably cause a fire.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_BARREL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15 normally, when exposed runs 1.12% faster
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}when his barrel is destroyed, he gets a massive speed boost

{FLAVOR}Once a wealthy factory owner, this zombie fell from grace when a group of Industrial Imps ripped him off. A story as old as time.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sturdy barrel keeps him greatly protected from damage.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}560 (face plate) + 340 (machine)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can steal face plate

{FLAVOR}Made out of only the most refined scrap metal. Programmed to love work and ask no questions. Under no circumstances should the face plate be removed from the model. Two-day delivery - free shipping.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Mass-produced machines that are about as unlively (and hungry) as their co-workers.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Likes to take long walks, and always dies a few times a day from the smog from work. But always finds himself back where he started.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Flag Labor Zombie finds the flag carrying gig to be quite a hassle. He really wants to get a new position, but he's a afraid of the judgement he’ll get. Not just from Dr. Zomboss, but his peers. Every zombie knows, no zombie wants to be the Flag Zombie. It takes commitment, something which a lot of zombies don’t have the capacity of comprehending. If he quits, he may not be accepted anymore. Maybe it would be better to just stick with it for now.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge steamy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FURNACE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}will unthaw from chill effects quicker
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}fire attacks do 20% more damage

{FLAVOR}It should be no surprise to learn that a furnace strapped to your back feels quite uncomfortable. Besides all the third-degree burns, it's just heavy! Unfortunately for Furnace Zombie, any type of advanced cooling system won't be invented until another 20 years. Unless the rumored Zomboni project speeds up development, that is.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FURNACE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot-tempered zombie with a hot-tempered furnace that combusts and destroys plants in a 3x3 radius upon defeat.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wrench
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches backwards Industrial Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}He’s sure to throw a wrench in those plants’ plans. If you don’t laugh at that joke, he will make you. He will. His hands are enormous.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Massive zombie who is sure to rebuild your defenses his way: walking over them.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}570
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stops to eat sun producing plants

{FLAVOR}Gentleman Zombie’s dancing skills are unrivaled by other zombies in his time. His integration of the umbrella is breathtaking, and when he opens it? Total showstopper.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Flies over past defenses and obstacles.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}There isn’t much to say about Industrial Imp. He’s had meetings with 50 different U.S. Presidents, has went to Mars and back, and found the key to immortality, but that’s about it. He’s recently taken on chess, and it’s proven as quite the challenge.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is launched into your defenses, then works his way backwards.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_INVENTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1650 (flying contraption) + 800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can steal her contraption's mechanical piece

{FLAVOR}Could you guess Inventor Zombie was an inventor? Besides the flying contraption (which her husband recently got stuck on), she's invented tons of other stuff, including (but not limited to): industrial machines, the light bulb, the wheel, and in a cruel twist of fate: the early prototype for the lawnmower.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_INVENTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Slowly flies over plants with her surprisingly sturdy flying contraption.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stands in place, cranking out Clockwork Zombies from his machine

{FLAVOR}The invention of Clockwork Zombies has spurred nothing but controversy among the many zombie labor unions. Some think they're a threat to the very unlivelyhoods that the workplace is meant to provide for. Others are critical of their sudden appearance. In general, a lot of mystery and paranoia surrounds their existence. But none know what Mechanic Zombie knows. None of them have noticed the plummeting number of fish in the River Thames as of recently...
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Produces steam-powered Clockwork Zombies from his mysterious machine.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}400 (wheelbarrow) + cart pusher
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wheelbarrow
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can also come equipped with trusty armor

{FLAVOR}Coal Miner Zombie is actually a super secret acronym for another super secret codename. C.M.Z.: Cyber Moochie Zoborbus. Don’t tell anyone, shhhhhhh!
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_H: Coal Miner Zombies push wheelbarrows of coal. When their carts are busted, burning coal is left behind.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_COAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 0.25 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to various status effects and knockback

{FLAVOR}Attempting to slack off on the job in a place where no one can find you seemed like the perfect crime, until it got to where you should hide. The worst part? He's STILL on the job. He's still thinking about his contingency plan, because where ever those wheelbarrows were taking him, it's nowhere good.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_COAL_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Coal Imp blocks damage and slowly burns your plants.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_TRAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900 (wheelbarrow) + cart pusher
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wheelbarrow
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can also come equipped with trusty armor

{FLAVOR}A coalition of miners and imps came together to create this new innovation in zombie transportation. No longer would they have to suffer with easily broken handles and an uncomfortable area for cargo. They got the idea for it on the train ride home from their shifts.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_TRAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Coal Train Zombies push coal with industrial grade supplies, making the process slower but more sturdy.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 + 1000 (repair station)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}repair station will be dropped upon defeat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}repair station repairs 400 health to machines every 2 seconds in a 3x3 radius
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss is grateful for a lot of things, but what he is most grateful for is the lack of imp labor laws during the industrial revolution.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Drops a repair station that heals mechanical allies upon defeat.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Constantly complains how he was fed lies about there being tons of gold at the end of a rainbow. All he found were cones. Maybe one day he'll notice that he went to the wrong end.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His lucky cone gives him double the health of a normal St. Paddy’s zombie.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Clearly remembers seeing a four-leafed clover somewhere.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket is so lucky that it even resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}St. Paddy's Zombie thought he was the luckiest zombie alive, then he got drafted to Holiday Mashup.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}He traded in a four-leafed clover for this lucky, one of a kind flag, said to give you all the luck in the world. So far all it did was make his arm tired.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge Irish-dancing "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with magical guitar
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Leprechaun Imp when damaged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bashes out sonic blasts at range, dealing 1000 damage

{FLAVOR}Many zombies wonder where he got the guitar from. His answer? The same place they got a parasol, a shovel, a torch and all the other wacky things zombies bring into battle: Walmart.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_: Oversized Irishman who yields his mighty guitar.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}instant-kill any plant on contact when jamming

{FLAVOR}Nobody knows that it takes 273 Lepreglitters to generate a rainbow. A fact which leaves many Lepreglitters desperate for work when it's not raining.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Trails glamorous rainbows that protect zombies behind her when she's feeling lucky.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_PUNK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}How fast Leprepunk kicks depends on his mood. If he's happy, he'll kick fast. If he's sad, he'll kick slow. If he's hungry, he'll kick a plant.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_PUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Moshes plants back a space when he feels like it.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_RA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Being colorblind doesn't dampen his excitement to dress in all blue for his favorite holiday, Springening!
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tries to steal sun, so that he can get rich.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Conehead keeps his cone close and his shades closer. But not too close, he’s claustrophobic.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cone - and more importantly, his sunglasses - give him double the toughness of ordinary summer zombies.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Buckethead's got everything he needs to keep the place bright wherever he goes. Don't tell anybody, but he's afraid of the dark.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His glow-in-the-dark bucket provides hearty damage protection.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Zombie loves sparklers. He carries them everywhere. He also burned down his house when he brought them inside. Now he wonders if he should keep the sparklers or not. Tough decision.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turns on his boom box for 8 seconds after reaching the sixth column
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}boombox has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz is the one day of the year where you get to express your love towards someone. Also buy lots of chocolate. Lots of it. That's what the ads on TV, the bumper stickers, and all the Valenbrainz cards at the supermarket said. So that's exactly what he did.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Holds aloft a chocolate "boombox" that tranquilizes all plants with its sappy tunes.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BUG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + Summer Zombie cargo
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Zombie's always going to summer night parties to light the place up. He saw a lightning bug there and was going to catch it, but then realized the lightning bug caught him. They've been best bugs ever since.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BUG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lightning Bug carries Summer Zombie in over ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}burning s'more destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish s'more

{FLAVOR}What's with all this Plants vs. Zombies nonsense? He just wants to grill for gosh's sake!
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Carries a burning s'more on a stick that can instantly destroy your plants.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}You’d expect the flag to just burn and turn into ashes from the sparklers, but there are other zombies that you should be questioning for things that don’t make any sense at all rather than something minor like this.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge sparkly "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with spatula
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses Hot Dog Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}4 years of chef training and 2 years of cooking classes were a mere waste of time. He does not, in fact, know how to cook. But tenderize? That's his speciality.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Oversized chef who is the king of the grill.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Hot Dog Imp uses all natural ingredients: corn syrup, sugar and VERY real meat. Definitely does NOT contain sewage and/or back hair.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is launched into your defenses, then tries to ketchup.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000 (burger) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (when in burger), 0.22 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to movement impairing effects until the burger is broken

{FLAVOR}He used to be empty like some sort of nothing burger.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION_H: A giant and protective burger that stops at most plants it encounters.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lands four tiles into your lawn

{FLAVOR}He swashes. He buckles. But, he also writes home every third Sunday and sends brains and treasure via post. He's a good zombie at heart.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Swings in on a rope to land midway onto your lawn.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}380
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates tombstones (700 HP) on the lawn

{FLAVOR}He dreams about playing fetch, running for the brains. He loves burying himself in the yard, and is not yet indoor trained. He's still looking for his tail.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Throws out bones to create tombstones.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Speed Details: {STAT}runs away after a short while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}carries treasure

{FLAVOR}The rare and wondrous Yeti carries his lunch box up and down Mount Brainer to his isolated mountain lodge.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A rare and curious creature, he always packs a lunch.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}After a wild night, Conehead Zombie woke up holding a mysterious receipt for a cone and industrial strength adhesive.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}There was a time when Buckethead Zombie was hailed as a zombie genius for his innovative bucket-on-head strategy. It's been a few years, though, and zombies wonder if he's got any surprises left. His secret? He doesn't.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bricks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}After consultation with various storybook wolves, it was determined that straw helmets and wood helmets were not up to snuff, and that brick helmets had to be seriously considered.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Brickhead Zombie's brick head provides thorough brickheaded brickheadness.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Basic Zombie hates the term "Basic." He doesn't consider himself some generic foe or common corpse. He's an individual, darn it, and he's going to make a difference even if it kills you.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A spelling impaired zombie named "Brian," Flag Zombie keeps thinking the rest of the zombies are talking to him. At least he feels important.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Rally Zombie splurged on the all-leather flag because, heck, he's worth it.
Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of a large clot or "pile" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar is the embodiment of power, made real. He is a juggernaut of hunger, from which there is no escape. He is fear unleashed. Well, he's fear slightly leashed.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H: Gargantuar really is kind of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}What he lacks in reach he more than makes up for with his bad attitude, or zombadittude as he likes to call it. Don't encourage him.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is hurled onto the lawn past your defenses, then shuffles ahead.
ZOMBIE_UNUSED_64_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}60 (poncho) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate (1100 HP)

{FLAVOR}The grate is his most prized possession. The poncho is there just to protect it from getting rusty. Also, he's looking for his mechanical horse.
ZOMBIE_UNUSED_64_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Conehead uses his cone for protection against flying peas, lasers, and watermelons, but also as protection against heartbreak. The cone is always there for him.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His cone hat makes him twice as irresistible - and also twice as tough.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Buckethead was in need of a prom date. He saw a bucket in the street and it was love at first sight. It’s kind of sad. Don’t pick prom dates off the street, kids.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His stylish bucket attracts dates and resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Love is in the air? Wrong. That is a zombie and you've fallen for his trap.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HE: Valenbrainz zombie with a balloon. Zombie will float above plants until balloon is popped.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Zombie just doesn't feel like he's getting anywhere with this whole "love" thing. They say you gotta open up your heart to succeed. He just wants to open the mind. Don't get the wrong impression: he's not much of an intellectual. He's just hungry.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Flag Zombie carries the balloons for a reason. He just likes to let his thoughts float away in hope that one day he will find love. You’d expect him to let the balloons float away after he does this, but he holds onto them, like the wallet he put in his ripped pocket.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Marks the arrival of a huge lovesick "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with heart pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Cupid Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}This Gargantuar believes that he's been blessed with a cupid's arrow. In reality, he's just way into Valenbrainz.
Enormous lovebug who crushes in more ways than one.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}First place winner of every cupid contest since 2015.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Floats over most of your defenses, then flutters onward.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}She finds it strikingly weird that she happened to be the only female zombie willing to associate herself with Valenbrainz, but she doesn't complain about it too much. All the constant attention she's been getting all but makes up for it.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Parasol provides great rejection for lobbed projectiles and too-forward confessions.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Being a fan of both Cupid and Stupid takes a toll on this zombie. Luckily, his explosive attitude more than makes up for it.
Blows up plants with his loving attitude.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}The ceramic confines of the Vase Gargantuar's home has done nothing to his endless hunger, his immense power, or his vast destructive potential. However, his footspeed could be better.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Phenomenally sized zombie stuffed into a tiny unliving space.
ZOMBIE_WEALTH_GOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}7000
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons lunar zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops yuanbao from the sky
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}switches lanes from time to time

{FLAVOR}While your standard cadaver is undead, this one's great fortune has lead him to be practically immortal! It would be utterly naive to even attempt to defeat this zombie! Unfortunately for him, that means he'll never have true respite from you and those pesky plants attempting to rob him blind whenever he appears. Maybe his fortune is failing him in that regard, but admitting such would be declaring defeat, and his pride won't allow that.
ZOMBIE_WEALTH_GOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A zombie of immeasurable wealth, ready to share his goodwill and fortune to fellow zombies to kick off a new, prosperous year.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Had dreams of becoming a rodeo clown but found the clown make-up to just be too creepy.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets launched past all but the tallest plants, then proceeds on foot.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1300
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 1 (stampeding)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a low flying imp rider over plants 2 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants blocks flying imp
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}He's not an angry bull. He loves flowers, playing in the fields, sitting under trees, and long walks across the pasture. He wants to settle down when he meets the right cow. Too bad he's a robot.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Can launch his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19 (normal), 2 (stampeding)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}charges multiple times, dealing 2000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a low flying imp rider over plants 2 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants blocks flying imp
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}"Legend" perhaps overstates Rodeo Legend Zombie's status in the rodeo world. Don't tell him that, though, unless you're desperate to hear an hour-long tirade about calf-roping.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Rodeo Legend Zombie smashes a plant and launches his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}"Workplace safety is no joke," is what they kept telling him at orientation. But easy for them to say. They're not the one stuck putting this oversized pinned book on top of their head every time they have to go to work.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A typical ZCorp employee, except with more on his mind.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp fully complies with all local, state and federal waste disposal ordinances.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: An environmentally friendly recycle bin protects the employee's noggin from damage.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Knows next to nothing about computers, other than the fact that they make very good headwear.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A typical ZCorp employee, except with better computer skills.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses zombies into other lanes
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}switches lanes or goes backward from time to time

{FLAVOR}Has started to regret consulting for the Holiday Mashup initiative. Building giant Zombots that get destroyed easily by literal Peashooters seems to be more of a financial liability now that she thinks about it.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: ZCorp Consultant speeds into the lawn, tossing zombies into other lanes.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Was tasked along with others to overlook the ongoing Holiday Mashup initiative. Considering using office employees as foot soldiers on a battlefield is usually considered a worker's rights violation, he would assume that this isn't going so well.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp branded office supplies are in limited supply - get one for your work cubicle now! All proceeds go straight into Dr. Zomboss' pockets. What? You think all those giant Zombots pay for themselves?
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: It's the combination of notebook and comically large pushpin that really gives this contractor the edge.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp encourages its contractors to come up with out-of-the-box solutions for keeping their heads safe.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Recycle bins make excellent and environmentally friendly headgear.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Once a member of ZCorp's IT department, Computerhead Contractor was demoted back to contractor after one-too-many lawsuits relating to her slamming computers onto Dr. Zomboss' head under the guise of "tech support."
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her computer skills, more specifically her ability to have an entire computer on her head, really gives this contractor the biggest edge.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Having been stuck at a dead end 9-to-5 job for almost 5 years now, you'd think applying for another similar job at ZCorp would be the last thing someone like her would want to do. But hey, they gave free coffee mugs at orientation!
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp developed its flag logo in-house and is very proud of it.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of huge corporate "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with his head
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Gargimp Legal when damaged

{FLAVOR}Head Office Impgantuar's door is always open. It is, however, highly inadvisable to take him up on that offer.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His giant noggin is a blunt instrument of smashing.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 (laptop) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (normal), 0.37 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage when angry
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes if defeated before he can throw his laptop, dealing 800 damage to nearby zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}becomes enraged after throwing his laptop (laptop deals 1000 damage)

{FLAVOR}His real passion is in plaid coat manufacturing. But alas, sometimes dreams don't come true in the corporate world we died in.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: ZCorp HelpDesk drops in and throws an exploding laptop.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with baseball bat, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}Gargimp Legal delivers cease-and-desists the old-fashioned way: with a baseball bat.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tiny but fierce, the Gargimp Legal department is the best and the beast in the business.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1150 (when on chair), 500 (zombie)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (zombie), 1 (when on chair)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}chair deals 5000 damage when it collided
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches over plants 2.5 tiles forward when chair collided
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}ZCorp Chair Racer brings fun and spontaneity to the zcorporate experience.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: ZCorp Chair Racer zooms in at high speed, collides with great impact, and catapults leftward with extraordinary grace.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mouth turbine can pull plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned zombie sharks can consume plants

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss meant it when he said the first iteration of this Zombot was a labor of love. He painstakingly tried to recreate the evil machinations day in and out to produce similar results to his previous attempt, to end up with an even bigger terror of the tides. The non-waterproof paintjob however, was an oversight he's willing to admit.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH2_DESCRIPTION_HE: The ravenous engine of carnage, back from the murky depths to turn the tide of this battle.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mouth turbine can pull plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned zombie sharks can consume plants

{FLAVOR}The Zombot Sharktronic Sub is a true labor of love. Dr. Zomboss obsessed over every detail of the aquatic mechanism of doom as he worked on it day in and day out from the wee hours of the morning until well after dark. He carefully handcrafted the shark's nearly impenetrable exterior skin. He shaved each razor-sharp tooth to a point by hand. And he painstakingly installed the lethal plant-consuming fan inside the machine's horrific maw all by himself. Zomboss shed more than one tear of joy when his masterpiece was complete. Say what you will about the evil genius, but he is passionate about his projects.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The ravenous engine of carnage from the murky depths.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes little damage from regular attacks
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can launch Cannonball Imps
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}magic attacks deal huge damage

{FLAVOR}"Perhaps my tricks and traps didn't work to sway those plants, but I refuse to give up on a form of entertainment with so much history and plant-destroying potential," cackles Dr. Zomboss, all while tapping out a jaunty little tune on his keyboard. Not long after the tune finished, his expression soured. "It's rigged! Those plants are cheaters, the lot of them! Why, if I didn't take over the carnival, so many wonders would have been left unearthed. I deserve to have that toybox!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION_HE: The mystery-filled circus-wagon of terrors and delights.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can target mine carts

{FLAVOR}Last time, the addition of a bull was merely an exception: a one off thing for Dr. Zomboss to take great pride in while extirpating your defenses. Now, however, it is the result of losing a bet, one which Dr. Zomboss is very much not proud of.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY2_DESCRIPTION_H: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds, back for a rematch from its previous defeat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can target mine carts

{FLAVOR}Ranchers and farmhands abandon your fields. Rumbling down the dusty trail, this wagon was engineered to strike fear into the heart of any horticulturist who should encounter it. Dr. Zomboss normally doesn't take any bull, but this time he made an exception.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION_HE: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies

{FLAVOR}Reforged in the depths of a volcano, the dragon was resurrected with a concoction of lava mixed with alchemy juices, 3 bat wings, some funny looking ring, and a strike from a lightning bolt. It's cool looking, and was definitely worth the trouble, but Dr. Zomboss is pretty sure he somehow managed to get his lab keys mixed into that as well.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The desolator of all from dark times, back to reclaim its throne.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies

{FLAVOR}With a rumble of destruction, Dr. Zomboss forged his Dark Dragon in the heart of a volcano. Then he tempered the beast in the chilled waters of Doom Lake. Finally  he fed its furnace with coal from the Mines of Morbidity. And the paint job - that was done by Carl.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: The desolator of all, from dark times.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates tar

{FLAVOR}It's funny how the first iteration is now the fossil, considering the look Dr. Zomboss opted for the newer version. Of course, he's really the only one who finds this fact amusing. Others are way more concerned with the fact that a 100 foot long metal dinosaur is now rampaging through the marsh and is about to stomp the life out of them at any moment.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction, striking the earth once more.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs

{FLAVOR}With flagrant disregard for temporal tidiness and simple good taste, Dr. Zomboss figured it would be a good idea to build a big metal dinosaur.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones

{FLAVOR}What Dr. Zomboss considered to be his first ever failure from his entire time-traveling journey, has been rebuilt from the scraps to once more be the horrible ancient curse put on your lawn.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT2_DESCRIPTION_HE: The destroyer of plants from ancient sands, reawakened by an ancient curse once more.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones

{FLAVOR}To add that extra bit of wickedness to the Sphinx-inator Dr. Zomboss chiseled his creation from the stonework of cursed tombs. You should not take this instance of reuse and recycle to mean he's going green. The only thing green about him is his tongue.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The destroyer of plants from the ancient sands.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks

{FLAVOR}They say that you can hear someone's true feelings through a performance of music. Music is the universal language that breaks all language barriers, delivering some of your deepest desires, ambitions, and drive through carefully constructed melodies. All of this was not lost on Dr. Zomboss, though he prefers to just scream into the mic and go with the flow, to an expected disappointment from the crowd.
An intimate comeback for Dr. Zomboss, with his more recent and agonizing explorations.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_BATTLEZ_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}manipulates time

{FLAVOR}When you've been through everything he has, can you really blame Dr. Zomboss for wanting some overdue vacation? Sadly, those inconsiderate plants seem to have paid this no mind and ruined the holidays for him anyways, which he notes will be the only present they ever regret opening.
The celebration-crashing creation of Dr. Zomboss' own naughty deeds.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks

{FLAVOR}In another world, in another time, Dr. Zomboss would receive the bounty of enthusiastic applause that is his due. Not here and now, though. Nope.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION_: An intimate evening with some of Dr. Zomboss’ most recent and painful explorations.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}venomballs leave behind poison puddles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}inhales and pulls plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}top head summons magic fog, bottom head shuffles Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}After Dr. Zomboss stumbled upon the magical forest, he immediately fell head over heels for the fantastical behemoth laid before him.

The Queen, however, laughs, thinking to herself how clueless the crazed mad scientist could be to be so easily puppeteered. A dream where the people she has grown to hate the most fight until they can no longer dream. A nightmare they cannot wake up from. Unfortunately, the tale could not end the way she wanted it to. With the beast slain, the queen retreated in solitude. Wandering around as the remaining days of her unlife keep flashing before her eyes. What's left is the same yearning for the past the former queen has always wanted, now devoid of the star she was once illuminated by. The times when she could still smile. When she was still happy.
A manifested creation of nightmares, awoken to tell a tragically ever after.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles

{FLAVOR}Outside of the fact that Dr. Zomboss loves the future for allowing him to reach a conclusion on how to repair his Zombots, he's still peeved that he doesn't feel like he fits in. He's going for a more "techno" and "out of this world" kind of look, but doesn't get the impression anyone appreciates it.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The power tile crushing creator from the further future, renovated.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles

{FLAVOR}When Dr. Zomboss is nestled into the comfy folds of his futuristic cerebral control pod he almost finds it hard to be evil. Of course once he sees a lawn full of happy plants that puts him right back where he needs to be, hungry and evil.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The Power Tile crushing creation from the Far Future.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can heal ice barrier over time

{FLAVOR}The synthetic fur was probably Dr. Zomboss' most brilliant idea yet. This time, however, he did not account global cooling into the mix, causing the Zombot to freeze up before he could even take it out for a spin. Dr. Zomboss might be an evil genius, but he'll never admit how scatterbrained he actually is.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past, invigorated by the cold of overdue revenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss was real impressed with himself when he came up with the idea to build a weaponized woolly mammoth with the power to blast snow and ice out of its mechanical trunk. But what Dr. Zomboss didn’t realize until it was too late: He’s allergic to mammoth fur. Now he has to load up on allergy medication every time he wants to take the darn thing out for a spin.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss' latest creation involved the implementation of aspects belonging to ancient civilizations, without understanding their historical meaning. Asked in a post-fight interview, Dr. Zomboss stated that he does not care and that it was essential to the machine's look, and shoo'd the press away. Needless to say, these statements are not helping his public image.
The floating fortress from the sky above, ascending once more to take on the challenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}After repeated failures with variously robotic engines of destruction, Dr. Zomboss decided to go with a kinder, more eco-friendly lighter-than-air option to sow disaster and discord.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION_: The floating fortress from the skies above.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}leaf blower blows away plants and pushes zombies forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires a tommy gun at plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spawns market cards and maid tables

{FLAVOR}Programming this machine was quite a chore. One bug denied any attempts at subtracting values from Klepto-maton's variables, another one made all pointers refer to themselves, and the script broke the binary system once, with the error log showing "Numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are mine!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION_HE: A sophisticated machine of avarice, expendable for nefarious means.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates fireballs and iceballs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}opens portals

{FLAVOR}Truth be told, Dr. Zomboss really can't help but miss the good old days. How he used to terrorize the neighborhood with his giant Zombot, complete with fireballs and an RV dispensary system. Of course, times change and he can no longer afford such a costly project, but he managed to settle with a smaller more compact version of his first ever evil project, now with more time manipulation to boot.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION_H: The menacing monstrosity of the Modern Day.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss put on a black coat of paint to impose a menacing image: that this ship would be the nightmare of every cargo ship full of plants unfortunate enough to be sailing by. Although, this has more to do with the excessive amount of black paint he stored below the deck that he had no idea what to do with.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas, reemerged from the depths to terrorize once again!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}"Hoist the mizzenmast, batten down the hatches! 15 zombies on a dead man's boat, yo ho ho and a bucket of brains!" Dr. Zomboss had to admit he was really getting into this whole pirate thing. Though he never thought he'd be on a boat on a boat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms into a fighter plane on final phase

{FLAVOR}Unlike Dr. Zomboss, General Camo doesn't have any fondness for giant robots as a strategy. He finds them too cumbersome and cost-inefficient, and while him using one would be seen as blasphemy due to his antediluvian style when it comes to conducting his attacks, General Camo has one secret rule that he's lived by from the moment he donned his first mask: the rule of cool is one to triumph all. And you best believe a giant robot vulture is as cool as it comes.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION_H: The great scourge of the skies.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imps from smokestack

{FLAVOR}Overtaking the position of a wealthy factory owner, Dr. Zomboss had easy access to all the materials and parts he needed to build the Loco-motive. Still having his blueprints for previous spider Zombots, Dr. Zomboss and his underpaid employees went to work, building a budget-friendly alternative to the usually expensive and draining production of one of his Zombots. Not out of a concern for the future prosperity of the workplace, but rather to grab more assets for himself to recover from his previous endeavor. Sure, he might be leaving the factory bankrupt after he leaves, but that's not going to cause any long-term problems, right?
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The derailer of defenses that's sure to bring the pain train.

ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Developing plant zomboids in eerie mimicry of zombie life is well within the boundaries of human experience," Zoybean Pod insists with a calm, unvarying steadiness.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zoybean Pods grow from sprouts to full pods, then split open to release helpful plant "zomboids" which attack zombies.
achieve_all_in_jest_desc: Complete a level where Jester Zombies return no projectiles
achieve_banana_storm_desc: Complete a Beach level using only Bananas to destroy zombies
achieve_big_kahunka_desc: Defeat the Deep Sea Gargantuars to collect their World Key
achieve_broadside_desc: Use a Coconut Cannon to destroy an Imp Cannon
achieve_dog_whisperer_desc: Destroy a Tomb Raiser before it can raise any gravestones
achieve_dragon_age_desc: Plant 10 Snapdragons in a single level
achieve_eighties_back_from_the_future_3_: Plant Thyme Warp three times in the same level
achieve_eighties_beet_it_desc: Complete a level using only Phat Beets to defeat zombies
